resources.string: Saved SIM unavailable (select a SIM on this device)
Concurrent use depends on the device, system and carrier. Using the secondary SIM network consumes its data allowance and may increase battery use.
Operation incomplete. Check root access and SIM status, then retry.
Activation request is running; Android has not validated the secondary network.

This feature requests and holds the non-default SIM network without changing the default data SIM. Whether both SIMs can provide data at the same time depends on the device, system and carrier. Data sent over the secondary network consumes the data allowance for that SIM. Stopping this feature releases the request made by this module; app-routing rules may keep the network active.
Two active SIMs must be identified. Activation is unavailable if discovery fails or is unsupported.
Request mode leaves dual-SIM properties unchanged. Compatibility mode temporarily changes a system property and restores it on normal stop. No automatic start at boot.
